landing.title: Create beyond the prompt.
landing.description: Miao is an open creative assistant for foundation models. Start from a conversation, call text, image, and video models, and keep every result on an infinite canvas.
landing.prompt: Create a quiet editorial campaign with a cinematic product reveal.
landing.modelsTitle: Choose the right model without breaking your flow.
landing.modelsDescription: Call text, image, and video models through one conversation — generate, edit, and keep going.
landing.featuresTitle: The conversation plans. The canvas remembers.
landing.featureAgentTitle: An intelligent creative assistant, not a prompt box
landing.featureAgentDescription: Develop the brief, resolve important choices, and run multi-step image or video workflows in one conversation.
landing.featureCanvasDescription: Generated media appears on a spatial canvas immediately. Compare directions, resize results, and reuse any frame as a reference.
landing.featureProjectsDescription: Keep sessions, assets, generation history, and canvas positions together inside focused projects.
landing.workflowTitle: A clear path through complex generation.
landing.workflowOneDescription: Share an idea, reference, or existing clip. Miao turns it into a concrete production plan.
landing.workflowTwoDescription: Confirm models, framing, duration, and references before compute is spent.
landing.workflowThreeDescription: Results arrive in place while they generate, ready for comparison, reuse, export, and the next instruction.
landing.openSourceDescription: Open source, local-first, bring your own keys. Projects, conversations, generation history, and media stay on your machine. You choose which models to connect.
landing.faqTitle: What to know before you start.
landing.faqOneAnswer: Miao calls text, image, and video models. It creates and edits stills and clips, and can plan multi-shot or long-form productions through an agent conversation.
landing.faqTwoQuestion: How does the infinite canvas work?
landing.faqTwoAnswer: Each generation appears as a movable canvas object. You can pan, zoom, arrange, compare, export, and reuse successful stills as references.
landing.faqThreeAnswer: Projects, conversations, canvas layouts, and locally archived media are stored on your machine. Generation requests are sent to the providers you configure.
landing.faqFourQuestion: Can I switch between English and Chinese?
landing.faqFourAnswer: Yes. The interface and product pages are available in English and Simplified Chinese, and Miao follows the language of your conversation.
landing.ctaTitle: Give your next idea room to grow.
landing.ctaDescription: Start with a sentence. Keep every frame, decision, and revision in one visual workspace.
landing.footerTagline: Models · Intelligence · Assistant · Open. Image and video creation on an infinite canvas.
